text: We evaluated label smoothing applied to the weak supervision targets on the ANLI testbed, using a smoothing coefficient of 0.2 and averaging over 5 seeds. The resulting performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.87. No baseline PGR was provided in the data supplied for this experiment, so we cannot characterize this number as an improvement over any comparison condition, nor can we say how much of the observed level is attributable to the smoothing intervention itself rather than to the underlying weak-to-strong setup. Likewise, no standard error or per-seed spread was reported, so the uncertainty around the 0.87 figure across the 5 seeds is unknown and the stability of the estimate cannot be assessed. The finding should therefore be read as a single point measurement: with label smoothing at 0.2 on weak labels, ANLI PGR stood at 0.87 over 5 seeds. A baseline arm and seed-level variance would be needed before drawing comparative conclusions.
